squat: Bar on your upper back, hands just outside shoulders, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Big breath, brace, sit down between your hips until thighs are at least parallel, then drive up through mid-foot.
Knees caving in or heels lifting. Push knees out over the toes.
fsquat: Bar on the front of the shoulders, fingertips under it, elbows high.
Sit straight down keeping the chest tall and elbows up, then stand.
Elbows dropping, which dumps the bar forward. Lead with the elbows.
bench: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinned back and down, feet planted, slight arch. Set the safeties.
Lower to the lower chest with elbows about 45 degrees, touch, press up and slightly back.
Elbows flared straight out or bouncing off the chest.
incline: Bench about 30 degrees, shoulder blades pinned, grip just wider than shoulders.
Lower to the upper chest under control, press straight up over the shoulders.
Bench set too steep (it turns into a shoulder press).
floorpress: Lie on the floor under the bar, knees bent, shoulder blades pinned.
Lower until the upper arms touch the floor, pause, press.
Letting the elbows crash into the floor. Touch softly and pause.
ohp: Bar in front of the shoulders, grip just outside them, glutes and abs tight.
Press straight up, move your head back then through once the bar passes your face, lock out overhead.
Leaning back into a standing incline press. Squeeze the glutes.
pushpress: Same setup as the overhead press, weight on the heels.
Short, fast dip with the knees, drive the legs, punch the bar overhead and lock out.
Dipping too deep or letting the knees go forward.
deadlift: Bar over mid-foot, shins near the bar, hips higher than knees, flat back, arms straight.
Pull the slack out, push the floor away, stand tall with the bar close, then hinge back down.
Rounding the lower back or jerking the bar off the floor.
rdl: Stand tall holding the bar at the hips, soft knees.
Push the hips back, slide the bar down the thighs until you feel the hamstrings, then drive the hips forward.
Turning it into a squat. Knees stay soft, hips go back.
slrdl: Hold the bell in one hand, stand on the opposite leg, soft knee.
Hinge forward, free leg reaching back, hips square, then stand back up.
Hips opening toward the ceiling. Keep both hip bones pointing down.
hipthrust: Upper back on the bench edge, bar padded across the hips, feet flat.
Drive through the heels, hips up until the body is flat, squeeze 1 second, lower.
Arching the lower back at the top. Tuck the ribs, chin down.
kbswingh: Bell a foot in front, hinge and grip it, flat back.
Hike it back, snap the hips forward to float it to chest height, let it fall back into the hinge.
Squatting the swing or lifting with the arms. It's a hip snap.
goodmorning: Bar on the upper back like a squat, soft knees.
Push the hips back, chest lowers toward parallel, flat back, then drive the hips through.
Rounding the back. Go only as low as you stay flat.
splitsq: Long split stance, dumbbells at your sides, torso tall.
Drop the back knee straight down near the floor, drive up through the front foot.
Front knee caving in or the stance too short.
gobletsq: Hold the bell at your chest, elbows down, feet shoulder width.
Sit deep between the knees, chest up, stand.
Heels lifting or the chest folding forward.
stepup: Dumbbells at your sides, one foot fully on the bench.
Drive through the top foot to stand on the bench, lower under control.
Pushing off the bottom foot. Make the top leg do the work.
lunge: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward, drop the back knee toward the floor, push back to start.
Short steps that push the knee way past the toes.
bulgarian: Back foot laces-down on the bench, front foot far enough out, dumbbells at your sides.
Lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches, drive up through the front heel.
Bouncing on the back leg. 90% of the work is the front leg.
revlunge: Hold the bell at your chest, stand tall.
Step back, drop the back knee, drive through the front foot to return.
Leaning forward over the front knee.
plank: Forearms under shoulders, body in one line, feet together.
Squeeze glutes and quads, ribs down, breathe and hold.
deadbug: On your back, arms up, knees over hips at 90 degrees.
Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor while the low back stays pressed down, return, switch.
Low back lifting off the floor. Shorten the reach until it doesn't.
hollow: On your back, press the low back into the floor.
Arms overhead, shoulders and feet just off the floor, hold the banana shape.
Low back arching up. Bend the knees to make it easier.
sideplank: On one forearm, elbow under shoulder, feet stacked.
Lift the hips so the body is a straight line, hold.
suitcase: Heavy bell in one hand, stand tall.
Walk with even steps, shoulders level, don't lean.
Leaning toward the bell. Fight to stay upright.
bearcrawl: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, knees an inch off the floor.
Crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot, back flat, hips low.
lateral: Dumbbells at your sides, slight bend in the elbows, slight forward lean.
Raise out to the side to shoulder height leading with the elbows, lower slowly.
arnold: Seated, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you.
Rotate the palms out as you press overhead, reverse on the way down.
Rushing the rotation or arching the back.
reardelt: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging.
Raise the arms out wide with a soft elbow, squeeze the back of the shoulders, lower slowly.
Using momentum or squeezing the shoulder blades instead of the rear delts.
dbpress: Seated tall, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press straight up until the arms are long, lower to ear level.
Arching the lower back off the pad.
kbbottoms: Bell upside down (bottom up) at the shoulder, crush the handle.
Press slowly overhead, keeping the bell balanced, lower with control.
Loose grip. Squeeze hard or it falls.
pushup: Hands just wider than shoulders, body in one line.
Lower the chest to the floor, elbows about 45 degrees, push back up.
dbincline: Bench about 30 degrees, dumbbells at the chest.
Press up and slightly in, lower to a deep stretch at the chest.
Clanking the bells together at the top and losing control.
dbfly: On a flat bench, dumbbells above the chest, soft elbows.
Open wide in an arc until you feel the chest stretch, squeeze back up.
Bending the elbows into a press, or going too heavy.
dbfloor: On the floor, knees bent, dumbbells at the chest.
Press up, lower until the upper arms touch the floor, pause, press.
Dropping the elbows hard onto the floor.
deficitpu: Hands on plates or bells so the chest can go below the hands.
Lower past hand level into a deep stretch, push back up.
curl: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl up without moving the elbows, squeeze, lower slowly.
Swinging the body or the elbows drifting forward.
hammer: Dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Curl up keeping the thumbs on top, lower slowly.
bbcurl: Shoulder-width grip, elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up, squeeze, lower over 2-3 seconds.
Leaning back to cheat the weight up.
inclinecurl: Lie back on a 45-60 degree bench, arms hanging straight down.
Curl without letting the elbows come forward, lower all the way.
Shortening the stretch at the bottom.
ohtri: One dumbbell held overhead with both hands, elbows pointing up.
Lower behind the head, extend back up.
skull: Lying on the bench, dumbbells above the shoulders, palms in.
Bend only at the elbows to lower beside the head, extend.
Elbows drifting. Keep the upper arms still.
cgpushup: Hands under the shoulders, elbows tight to the ribs.
Lower with elbows brushing the sides, push up.
Elbows flaring out (it becomes a chest push-up).
kickback: Hinge forward, upper arm tight to the side and parallel to the floor.
Straighten the elbow back, squeeze, return.
bbrow: Hinge to about 45 degrees, flat back, bar hanging.
Row to the belly button, squeeze, lower under control.
dbrow: One hand and knee on the bench, flat back, bell hanging.
Pull the elbow toward the hip, pause, lower to a full stretch.
Twisting the torso to heave the weight.
pendlay: Bar on the floor, torso nearly parallel, flat back.
Explode the bar to the lower chest, lower it back to the floor each rep.
gorilla: Two bells between the feet, deep hinge, flat back.
Row one bell while pushing the other into the floor, alternate.
csrow: Chest down on an incline bench, dumbbells hanging.
Row up and back, squeeze the shoulder blades, lower.
Lifting the chest off the pad.
renegade: Push-up position on dumbbells, feet wide.
Row one bell to the hip, set it down, row the other, keep the hips square.
thruster: Dumbbells at the shoulders, feet shoulder width.
Front squat down, drive up and press overhead in one motion.
Pausing between the squat and press.
kbcp: Bell between the feet, hinge and grip.
Clean it to the rack position, then press overhead, lower and repeat.
Bell banging the forearm. Let it roll, don't flip it.
squatpress: Squat deep, stand, then press overhead.
Pressing before standing all the way up.
powerclean: Bar over mid-foot, hips higher than a deadlift, arms long.
Push up from the floor, jump and shrug when the bar passes the knees, pull under and catch on the shoulders with elbows high.
Pulling with the arms early. Legs, then hips, then arms.
hangclean: Stand tall, bar at the thighs, slide it to just above the knees.
Jump and shrug, whip the elbows under, catch high on the shoulders.
Dipping the knees too far forward.
powersnatch: Wide grip, bar over mid-foot, hips high, flat back.
Push up, jump and shrug, pull under and punch the bar overhead, catch in a quarter squat.
Swinging the bar away from the body. Keep it close.
hangsnatch: Wide grip, bar just above the knees.
Drive the hips, shrug, punch overhead and lock out.
Pressing out the lockout. Punch it fast.
dbhangclean: Dumbbells at the thighs, soft knees.
Jump the hips, shrug, flip the bells onto the shoulders.
Curling the bells up instead of using the hips.
dbsnatch: One dumbbell between the feet, hinge.
Drive the hips, pull the bell close, punch it overhead in one move.
Pressing it up at the end.
kbclean: Bell between the feet, hike it back.
Drive the hips, keep the elbow close, let the bell roll onto the forearm in the rack.
Swinging it wide so it crashes onto the wrist.
kbsnatch: Bell a foot in front, hike it back.
Drive the hips, pull high, punch the hand through so the bell turns over softly overhead.
Letting it flop over onto the wrist.
trxrow: Face the anchor, hold the handles, walk the feet forward and lean back with straight arms, body straight.
Pull the chest to the hands, squeeze the shoulder blades, lower slowly.
Hips sagging. Walk the feet in to make it harder.
trxsarow: One handle, feet set, body square to the anchor.
Row the elbow to the ribs, lower slowly.
Twisting open to cheat the rep.
trxpress: Face away from the anchor, arms straight in front, lean forward.
Lower the chest between the hands, press back to straight arms.
Letting the straps rub your arms. Keep hands at chest width.
trxpushup: Feet in the foot cradles, hands on the floor, plank.
Lower the chest to the floor, push up, keep the hips level.
trxyfly: Face the anchor, arms straight in front, lean back.
Raise the arms into a Y overhead, thumbs up, lower slowly.
trxtfly: Face the anchor, arms straight in front, lean back.
Open the arms out to a T, squeeze the upper back, return slowly.
trxfacepull: Face the anchor, palms facing down, lean back.
Pull the handles to your ears with elbows high, finish with thumbs back.
Pulling to the chest instead of the face.
trxcurl: Face the anchor, palms up, arms straight at shoulder height, lean back.
Curl the hands toward the forehead keeping the elbows fixed, lower slowly.
trxtricep: Face away, arms straight in front, lean forward.
Bend only at the elbows to bring the hands beside the head, extend back out.
trxsquat: Face the anchor, hold the handles lightly, arms straight.
Sit back deep, then drive up through the heels.
Pulling yourself up with the arms.
trxpistol: Face the anchor, one leg out in front.
Sit as low as you can control on one leg, stand back up.
trxlunge: Face away, back foot in the foot cradle.
Drop the back knee straight down, drive up through the front heel.
Front knee drifting way past the toes.
trxhamcurl: On your back, heels in the cradles, hips lifted.
Pull the heels toward the glutes keeping the hips up, extend slowly.
trxpike: Feet in the cradles, hands on the floor in a plank.
Lift the hips straight up over the shoulders with straight legs, lower to a plank.
trxtuck: Pull the knees to the chest, extend back to a plank.
trxplank: Feet in the cradles, forearms on the floor.
Hold a straight line, ribs down, don't let it swing.
trxsideplank: Feet stacked in the cradles, one forearm down.
trxclimber: Feet in the cradles, hands under the shoulders.
Drive the knees in one at a time, fast, hips steady.
reversecrunch: On your back, knees bent, hands by your sides.
Curl the hips off the floor toward the ribs, lower slowly.
bicycle: On your back, hands lightly behind the head, legs up.
Turn one elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg extends, switch.
Pulling the neck. Turn the shoulders instead.
vup: Lie flat, arms overhead, legs straight.
Lift the arms and legs together to meet in the middle, lower with control.
legraise: On your back, hands under the hips, legs straight.
Raise the legs to vertical, lower slowly until just off the floor.
Low back arching off the floor.
hollowrock: Hollow hold position: low back down, arms and legs long.
Rock back and forth while holding the shape.
flutter: On your back, hands under the hips, legs just off the floor.
Small fast kicks, low back pressed down.
Legs too high (makes it easy) or back arching.
russiantwist: Sit, lean back about 45 degrees, chest tall, bell at the chest.
Turn the shoulders side to side, tapping the bell beside each hip.
Moving only the arms. Turn the ribs.
dbsitup: Feet anchored, dumbbell held on the chest.
Sit all the way up, lower slowly.
woodchop: Dumbbell in both hands high over one shoulder, feet wide.
Chop diagonally down across the body to the opposite hip, pivot the back foot.
Bending the arms and just lifting.
kbwindmill: Bell locked out overhead, feet angled away from it.
Push the hips toward the bell side and lower the free hand to the floor, eyes on the bell, stand back up.
Bending the top arm. Keep it locked.
getup: On your back, bell locked out over the shoulder on the same side as the bent knee.
Roll to the elbow, to the hand, bridge the hips, sweep the leg under, kneel, stand. Reverse it down.
Rushing. Each step is slow and the bell stays locked.
birddog: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Reach the opposite arm and leg long, hips level, pause 2 seconds, switch.
shouldertap: Tap each hand to the opposite shoulder without the hips moving.
hipdip: Dip the hip to the floor, drive it high, repeat.
copenhagen: Side plank with the top leg on the bench at the knee or ankle.
Lift the bottom leg up to the bench and hold the body straight.
Hips sagging. Use the knee on the bench to make it easier.
bearhold: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Lift the knees an inch off the floor and hold, back flat, breathing.
trxchestfly: Face away from the anchor, arms straight in front at chest height, soft elbows, lean forward.
Open the arms wide until you feel the chest stretch, then squeeze the hands back together.
Bending the elbows into a press. Walk the feet back to make it harder.
trxatomic: Feet in the cradles, push-up position.
One push-up, then pull the knees to the chest, extend.
trxfallout: Face away, arms straight in front, lean forward from the ankles.
Let the arms rise overhead as you fall into a long plank, pull back with the abs.
Arching the low back. Ribs down.
trxbodysaw: Forearm plank with feet in the cradles.
Rock the body forward and back from the shoulders.
Hips sagging as you rock back.
trxoblique: Drive both knees toward one elbow, return, alternate.
trxpowerpull: One handle, face the anchor, free arm reaching toward the floor.
Rotate down toward the floor, then row and twist back up, free arm reaching to the sky.
trxhighrow: Face the anchor, palms down, arms straight at shoulder height, lean back.
Pull with elbows high and wide until the hands reach the chest line.
Dropping the elbows (that's a regular row).
trxhippress: On your back, heels in the cradles, legs straight.
Drive the hips up off the floor, squeeze 1 second, lower.
Arching the back instead of using the glutes.
trxsprinter: Face away, lean into the straps, one foot back.
Drive the back knee up fast into a sprint position, step back.
trxsquatrow: Face the anchor, holding the handles, arms straight.
Squat down, then as you stand, row the hands to the ribs.
trxsideplankreach: Feet stacked in the cradles, side plank on the forearm.
Reach the top arm under the body, then up to the ceiling.
kbswing: Bell a foot in front, hinge and grip it.
Hike it back, snap the hips to float it to chest height, let it fall back.
Squatting the swing or lifting with the arms.
burpee: Drop the hands, jump the feet back, chest to the floor, jump the feet in, jump up.
